startX, targetProbability = map(float, input().split())
startX = int(startX)
position = startX

def check(good, bad, p):
    g = float(good)
    b = float(bad)
    numerator = (0.25 * b * max(0, b - 1) * g
                 + (g * (max(0, g - 1) * max(0, g - 2) / 6.0) + b * 0.5 * g * max(0, g - 1)))
    denominator = (g + b) * max(0, g + b - 1) * max(0, g + b - 2) / 6.0
    ans = numerator / denominator
    return ans >= p

stepSize = startX
while stepSize > 0:
    while position - stepSize >= 0 and check(position - stepSize, startX - (position - stepSize), targetProbability):
        position -= stepSize
    stepSize //= 2

print(position)
